name: f2-hbm-burst200
label: measured
description: Alex's burst200 F2 image: one openTPU slice at 200 MHz on the F2's HBM over 2 pseudo-channels, 4 GiB addressable. The image is a routed DCP in S3 (no HBM-shell RTL source in this repository); the programs are openTPU's. This is the image behind the 2026-10-16 board baselines.

pin.rtl_source: not in the repository (Alex's DCP: aws-fpga cl_mem_hbm_wrapper + 2x otpu_native_axi + f2_mem BD)
pin.software_rev: ternary-bonsai c52ba1113888432a3ed30a6a69e7f54ffcf4e63c (docs/ternary.md 5, docs/wide_port.md 'Baseline on the board')

refresh.note: device refresh not observable from the host; not measured

uncertain: outstanding reads per channel in Alex's bridge

measured.tool: tools/f2_bench.py via otpu-serve (card sampler, greedy, 128 tokens max); raw JSON receipt not in this repository (lives on the F2 host)

gemma3-1b-int8.metric_notes: decode = tokens after the first / their interval (client side); prefill = prompt tokens / client TTFT: a serving metric, not device prefill throughput; TTFT = request to first streamed token
